page.content:
Fink and Cranor's desert radio town of Cecil, Carlos, angels, and the Glow Cloud.

How Welcome to Night Vale connects

  • Creator: Joseph Fink — Joseph Fink co-created Welcome to Night Vale.
  • Creator: Jeffrey Cranor — Jeffrey Cranor co-created Welcome to Night Vale.
  • Work: Welcome to Night Vale (show) — The show is the flagship work of Welcome to Night Vale.
  • Work: Welcome to Night Vale (novel) — The 2015 novel extends Welcome to Night Vale into prose.

What is Welcome to Night Vale?

Welcome to Night Vale is the twice-monthly podcast Joseph Fink and Jeffrey Cranor write: Cecil Palmer's community-radio voice from a desert town of forbidden dog parks, StrexCorp takeovers, angels in Old Woman Josie's yard, and a Glow Cloud the City Council asks you to hail.

Key threads lead to Joseph Fink, Jeffrey Cranor, Welcome to Night Vale (show) and Welcome to Night Vale (novel).
